items.t: Said the state is experiencing senseless gun violence and a proliferation of guns in circulation.
items.q: It’s just senseless gun violence," Simmons said. "What we are experiencing now is just a proliferation of guns just being in circulation.

items.t: Said law enforcement was warranted in initially investigating the church burning as a hate crime, given the history of burnings of African-American churches in the Deep South.
items.q: The way law enforcement authorities initially investigated this matter as a hate crime I believe was warranted, considering the past and the history.

record.t: Served as chair of the Enrolled Bills Committee.
record.q: Enrolled Bills: Chair Derrick Simmons, Vice-chair Robert Jackson

record.t: Was named a member of the Senate Select Committee on Redistricting and Reapportionment.
record.q: Membership includes Senators Briggs Hopson, Josh Harkins, Brice Wiggins, Jeremy England, Lane Taylor, Mike Thompson, Daniel Sparks, Derrick Simmons, and Angela Turner Ford.

record.t: Sponsored Senate Bill 2469, which would direct the State Personnel Board to implement an across-the-board increase in state employee salaries.
record.q: Senate Bill 2469 - Simmons - State employee salaries; direct State Personnel Board to implement across-the-board increase.

record.t: Co-sponsored Senate Bill 2906 with Blount, which would repeal PERS Tier 5 while providing a different COLA for new hires.
record.q: Senate Bill 2906 - Blount, Simmons - PERS; repeal Tier 5, but provide a different COLA for new hires
